name: Rice Yellow Mottle Virus
description: A serious viral disease of rice in Africa, causing yellow mottling, stunting, and poor grain filling. It is mechanically transmitted by leaf contact and beetles.
symptoms: Yellow to pale green mottling on leaves
Stunted plant growth with reduced tillering
Delayed flowering and poor panicle exsertion
Leaves may become necrotic in severe infections
causes: Rice yellow mottle virus mechanically transmitted
Direct plant-to-plant contact in dense stands
Continuous rice cultivation with volunteer plants
treatments: No chemical cure for viral infection
Control beetle vectors with insecticides where practical
prevention: Avoid mechanical damage during weeding operations
Clean tools between fields to prevent mechanical transmission
Practice field hygiene and remove volunteer rice
